title: Nextbridge capability taxonomy v1
description: Controlled vocabulary for capabilities. Two levels only: categories and capabilities. Derived from the Phase 0 audit, not invented ahead of it.

category.description: Required. Every capability belongs to exactly one category, so an orphan cannot drift in unnoticed.

note.description: Why this capability is distinct from a near neighbour. Present wherever a merge would erase a product boundary.

capabilities.description: No products field. The product list per capability is computed by the compiler; storing it here would create a second source of truth.
